name: Service principal
short_description: The identity an application uses to sign in within a Microsoft Entra tenant. Agent identities are built as a special kind of service principal.

evidence.quote: An agent identity is a special kind of service principle inside Microsoft Entra
وأخيرا بدء الاستيراد باستخدام Service Principal وليس أبدا باستخدام حساب عادي
a service principle with tenant-wide graph permissions hasn't been rotated in two years
Service principles with client secrets, certificates that expire at the worst possible moment
